profile.reading: Emailage was a Chandler, Arizona-based fraud-prevention and email-risk-scoring software company, acquired by LexisNexis Risk Solutions and now marketed as LexisNexis Emailage. It built analytics software that helps online merchants and financial institutions score transaction risk by email address. It was a software company that ran on cloud and outsourced infrastructure rather than one that operated its own colocation or hosting facility, and a check of the address on file today finds a different, unrelated tenant in place. Nothing publicly available ties this specific address to server or data center infrastructure, and this entry does not present a software company's former office as a data center facility.

reading.body:
This entry does not represent a data center facility. Emailage was a fraud-prevention software company acquired by LexisNexis Risk Solutions, a consumer of cloud infrastructure rather than an operator of one. The address on file now hosts a different tenant, Safe T Professionals LLC.

The Maricopa County coordinates resolve to a former office building, not compute infrastructure. OpenStreetMap tagged this location as a data center, but reverse geocoding and business records confirm the current occupant runs unrelated operations. No published sources connect this address to server capacity, hosting services, or colocation infrastructure of any kind.

This entry should not be counted among Arizona's AI infrastructure inventory. It represents a data quality problem, not a building constraint on compute availability. Removing it does not change Arizona's actual power capacity for AI workloads, which depends on facilities with verifiable specifications and active infrastructure operations.
